blocks.tamil_translation: When Hazrat Abu Sufyan ibn Harb (RA), the father of Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA), the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, died, I went to Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA). Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA) sent for a perfume which was yellow because something like khaluq had been mixed into it, took a little of it and applied it to her slave girl. Then she also took some of it herself and rubbed it on her cheeks, and after that said, “By Allah! I have no need to apply perfume now. (But) I have heard the Prophet ﷺ say, ‘It is not permissible for any woman who has Iman in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days for the death of anyone except her husband’; for the death of the husband she must mourn for four months and ten days. (That is why I applied the perfume.)’ Hazrat Zainab (RA) said that Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA) said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Khaluq is the name of a perfume with a large amount of saffron added to it.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: مَتَي السَّاعَةُ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لَهَا؟ قَالَ: مَا أَعْدَدْتُ لَهَا مِنْ كَثِيرِ صَلوةٍ وَلَا صَوْمٍ وَلَا صَدَقَةٍ وَلكِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللهَ وَرَسُولَهُ قَالَ: أَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب علامة الحب في الله ......، رقم:٦١٧١
blocks.tamil_translation: “A man asked the Prophet ﷺ, “When will the Day of Qiyamah come?’ The Prophet ﷺ asked, “What preparation have you made for it?’ “I have not prepared many (Nafl) Salahs, nor many (Nafl) fasts, nor much charity for the Day of the Hereafter,
